maddeler.e:
يستجهلوا (form X)
# يَسْتَجْهِلُوا (yastajhilū) /jas.tad͡ʒ.hi.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
# يُسْتَجْهَلُوا (yustajhalū) /jus.tad͡ʒ.ha.luː/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَجْهَلَ (istajhala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
